- **Attack Speed Scaling**: 1% per 5% bonus Attack Speed from permanent sources ⇒ **1% per 4% bonus Attack Speed from permanent sources**

changes.title: Yone
changes.body:
> The last changes to Yone successfully got him to start considering crit in his first item purchases, but also put him at a somewhat unsustainable power level. We are giving him a moderate nerf to bring him down a bit.

---

#### Q - Mortal Steel

- **Damage**: 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 (+110% AD) ⇒ **25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 (+105% AD)**

changes.title: Zyra
changes.body:
> Like Vel'koz, Zyra has had relatively little impact in the meta as tanks and enchanter supports have reigned supreme. We’re giving Zyra a greener thumb this patch to help her combat the forces trampling over her plants.

---

#### W - Rampant Growth

- **Seed Ammo Cooldown**: 18 / 16 / 14 / 12 / 10s ⇒ **16 / 14.5 / 13 / 11.5 / 10s**

changes.title: Bastion Breaker
changes.body:
> Bastion Breaker was buffed into being a bit of a generic stat stick in order to give it a proper swing in the meta. Now, we’re nerfing that generic power with a QoL improvement to keep it a satisfying item in its niche.

- **Lethality**: 22 ⇒ **18**
- **Shaped Charge Damage**: 50 Melee + 1.5/Lethality / 25 Ranged + 0.75/Lethality ⇒ **40 Melee + 1.5/Lethality / 20 Ranged + 0.75/Lethality**
- **Sabotage Duration**: 90s ⇒ **Infinite**
- **Sabotage Duration Context**: This is how long you have to use the bonus damage against objectives.

---

![](https://am-a.akamaihd.net/image?f=https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/16.18.1/img/item/6621.png)

Dawncore

> Dawncore is the enchanter capstone that isn’t, and currently only Soraka picks it up. Even when other supports get to full build, they often prefer other purchases. We’re buffing its AP value to make it less purely bound to Healing and Shielding.

- **Ability Power per 100% Base Mana Regeneration**: 10 ⇒ **15**

---

![](https://cmsassets.rgpub.io/sanity/images/dsfx7636/news_live/9b1ba3fbc73a4aadea8c057f78f00fa82d3820ba-512x512.png)

Gluttonous Greaves

> The greaves are overperforming for marksmen, even when getting very few stacks, so we’re hitting it with a nerf to its cost to delay early acquisitions from getting too much value.

- **Total Cost**: 1000g ⇒ **1100g**

---

![](https://am-a.akamaihd.net/image?f=https://ddragon.leagueoflegends.com/cdn/16.18.1/img/item/6697.png)

Hubris

> While Hubris has been a bit weak for melee champions, it’s clearly been overperforming for ranged users. We’re delineating between the two now to encourage melees and disincentivize ranged users from building it.

- **Base Bonus Attack Damage**: 12 ⇒ **15 Melee / 10 Ranged**
- **Bonus Attack Damage per Stack**: 3 ⇒ **3 Melee / 2 Ranged**

changes.title: Headliners
changes.body:
- **K/DA**: Collect 4 K/DA Cards to earn an extra Augment!
- **HEARTSTEEL**: Augments can come with unique modifiers making them extra strong.
- **True Damage**: Takedowns and destroying towers can drop Anvils for your team.
- **Pentakill**: Increase the power of one of your abilities at the start of the game and at level 18.
- **Disco**: Dance under the disco ball to earn Gold for everyone.
- **Cafe Cuties**: Health relics are especially powerful.
- **Bees**: Collect the honey pots and avoid the bees that fly across the map.
- **Command Line**: Reroll one of your augments to be a higher tier in every selection.
- And more to come????

changes.title: Champions
changes.body:
** NEW **** - Mordekaiser**

> Mordekaiser is back with his kit from 2010-2015! Would you like to eat every single possible minion wave, plus both your and your enemy’s Wraith camps? Mordekaiser is the champion for you. All his abilities cost health, but damaging enemies generates a shield, so you can keep fighting no matter how low you go. And when it’s time to win a fight, your ultimate can turn it into a 6v4. Beat them with their own AD Carry!

changes.title: Passive - Iron Man
changes.body: - Mordekaiser converts damage dealt by his abilities into a decaying shield.

changes.title: Q - Mace of Spades
changes.body: - Mordekaiser’s next attack damages multiple nearby enemies. If his target is isolated, he deals extra damage to them.

changes.title: W - Creeping Death
changes.body: - Mordekaiser buffs an ally with a swarm of shrapnel that grants bonus armor and MR and damages nearby enemies over time.

changes.title: E - Siphon of Destruction
changes.body: - Mordekaiser deals magic damage to enemies in a cone. That’s it. That’s the tooltip.

changes.title: R - Children of the Grave
changes.body:
- Mordekaiser curses an enemy champion, dealing damage over time and stealing their stats. If the target dies while cursed, Mordekaiser raises their spirit as a controllable ghost.

---

** NEW **** - Yorick**

> Ghostman yannik cannot compete to mojo style master yu, but he can do the babushka trick to make him double the champion and unleash omen of smell and omen of battle. If that didn’t make any sense to you, you missed out on an all-timer of a forum post. Yorick is back to his original version from 2011-2016, summoning ghouls with every ability he casts and cloning or temporarily reviving his teammates. If you want a quick jumpstart to playing Yorick to his frustratingly immovable best, consider maxing Omen of Famine and getting an early Chalice of Harmony so that you’ll never run out of mana as you constantly drain your opponents and heal while doing so.

changes.title: Passive - Unholy Covenant
changes.body: - Yorick takes reduced damage and his attacks deal bonus damage for every summon he has active. This counts his Q, W, E, and R.

changes.title: Q - Omen of War
changes.body: - Yorick’s next attack deals bonus damage and summons a Spectral Ghoul. Spectral Ghouls have bonus attack damage and movement speed, and give Yorick bonus movement speed while they live.

changes.title: W - Omen of Pestilence
changes.body: - Yorick summons a Decaying Ghoul in an explosion that damages and slows all nearby enemies. Decaying Ghouls continue to slow enemies around them.

changes.title: E - Omen of Famine
changes.body: - Yorick summons a Ravenous Ghoul, damaging an enemy and healing himself in the process. Ravenous Ghouls heal Yorick every time they attack an enemy.

changes.title: R - Omen of Death
changes.body:
- Yorick conjured the revenant of an allied champion, who can attack for a portion of their total attack damage. If the ally dies while the revenant is active, they are temporarily revived to fight at full power.

---

** NEW **** - Hecarim**

> Hecarim was released in 2012 and hasn’t changed that much over the years, only undergoing some minor mechanical updates to his Q and W. Overall, he goes fast, dives in, and has strong sustained damage while galloping alongside his foes.

changes.title: Passive - Warpath
changes.body: - Hecarim is ghosted and gains Attack Damage based on his bonus Move Speed.

changes.title: Q - Rampage
changes.body: - Hecarim cleaves nearby enemies. If he hits an enemy with it, the cooldown of the next cast will be reduced.

changes.title: W - Spirit of Dread
changes.body: - Hecarim damages nearby enemies over time and heals based on damage dealt to enemies in the area.

changes.title: E - Devastating Charge
changes.body: - Hecarim gains Move Speed and causes his next attack to deal bonus damage and knock the target back.

changes.title: R - Onslaught of Shadows
changes.body:
- Hecarim charges forward, summoning spectral riders that damage enemies they hit. Hecarim inflicts fear on all nearby enemies when ending his charge.

---

** NEW **** - Lucian**

> Lucian is the newest champion to grace League Classic, as he was released in the back half of 2013, but we couldn’t release a bunch of Shadow Isles champions without having our old pal back to keep them in check. There are a few small differences to Lucian here compared to the one you may have played recently. Most notably, he has 550 attack range, which makes him an extremely potent laner.

changes.title: Passive - Lightslinger
changes.body: - After casting an ability, Lucian’s next attack fires twice.

changes.title: Q - Piercing Light
changes.body: - Lucian fires a piercing shot that damages enemies in a line.

changes.title: W - Ardent Blaze
changes.body: - Lucian fires a cross-shaped missile that damages and marks enemies. Damaging marked enemies gives Lucian bonus move speed.

changes.title: E - Relentless Pursuit
changes.body: - Lucian dashes and removes all slows affecting him. Unlike the modern version of this spell, it doesn’t reset his attack timer and its cooldown is only refreshed by champion kills during his R.

changes.title: R - The Culling
changes.body:
- Lucian rapidly fires shots in a straight line. He can move and cast Relentless Pursuit while firing.

---

**Aatrox**

> Aatrox isn’t doing so well, especially in top lane, so we’re delivering some level-scaling buffs and overall tankiness buffs to help top lane more than jungle. These are buffs from 2014 and 2015, before his first minor rework in 2017.

**Irelia**

> Say it with me now, “Better nerf Irelia!” Indeed, she’s come out too powerful, so we’re here to bring her down to size. We’re making her weaker by reverting some buffs from back in 2012, making her less outright durable and forcing her to rely on her high mobility and clever target selection. We’re also adjusting her passive to stack with Mercury Treads like it used to, which is a nerf whenever she builds Tenacity items.

changes.title: Mythic Shop Update
changes.body: > As a heads up, during Patch 26.22, we’ll be making changes to the Mythic Shop so that each player will start to see offerings unique to them, rather than everyone having the same selection at a given time. - Fixed a bug where Nidalee’s (Q) spear damage could go through spell shields at max range.
- Updated SFX to use the base skin’s ult SFX for Briar, Kled, and Sion when playing against them to improve clarity.
